name: Ultrasonic Waves
doc: Ultrasonic Waves (Red Bat's attack): the root and the controller - the waves, the rings flying to the target, the three bursts at the target, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag152_ultrasonic_waves.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the module, its packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Controller
parts.doc: The waves, the rings flying to the target, the three bursts at the target, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the controller

params.label: Wave
params.doc: The sprite sequence wave (a flipbook of 12 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Burst a
params.doc: The sprite sequence burst a (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Burst b
params.doc: The sprite sequence burst b (a flipbook of 8 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Burst c
params.doc: The sprite sequence burst c (a flipbook of 8 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Ring model
params.doc: The prim model ring (a mesh of 25 vertices, 16 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Ring colours
params.doc: its colour words (red, green, blue, the GPU code byte), picked in turn (40 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)
